  nameResolution:
    component: sqlite
    version: v1

metadata:
  name: statestore
spec:
  type: state.redis
  version: v1
  metadata:
    - name: redisHost
      value: "127.0.0.1:10776"
    - name: actorStateStore
      value: "true"

  - eventstore
